content: PostgREST maintains a schema cache; DDL changes (including CREATE TYPE/ALTER TYPE for enums, new columns) require a cache reload to be visible to the REST API. Supabase-hosted projects auto-run an event trigger that fires NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema' on DDL commands, so normal migrations via supabase db push should self-refresh. If a newly added enum column or type isn't visible via the Data API immediately after a migration, manually run NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema'; as a most-reliable fallback, restarting via Dashboard 'Restart project' also clears the cache. Rapid successive NOTIFY events can be coalesced/dropped, so don't assume every DDL statement in a multi-statement migration triggers its own reload.
